Moves every song\'s lyrics a little earlier or later, on top of a song\'s own timing. For a phone, speaker or headphones that play the sound late, so the words light up with the voice again. It changes at once, also for the song playing.

What goes into your files with the lyrics. Word timings are saved as enhanced LRC, which Poweramp and other karaoke-capable players read; players that don\'t read it show the word times as text. The translation goes under each line, in your translation language.
